verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents public REST APIs: headless checkout, wallets, onramp/offramp create and get order endpoints, and agent checkouts. It also has an API reference that lets you call the APIs live from the browser, plus documented API keys. That is enough for an AI-native user to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Crossmint's headless checkout API is a set of REST APIs that allow you to integrate credit card and cross-chain crypto payments inside your app with full control of the user experience.
The reference pages allow you to call the APIs directly from the browser.
Creates an onramp order to buy tokens with a card. The order returns a payment intent that the buyer completes to receive tokens in the specified wallet.
Crossmint offers secure, programmable smart wallet infrastructure through a single API that is configurable for any use case
